corrected_failures: Fresh review found nonreflexive AVOC labels that declared sufficiency but failed decoding; accepted labels now require consistent reflexive scalar equality.
A direct shell constructor could consume an unbounded iterator; it now requires and bounds a finite sequence before copying.
Fixed-width NumPy components inside exact inputs caused overflow, zero products, bit_length failures and allocation-cap bypasses; accepted arithmetic inputs now own Python integer components.

Previous PR CI failed Windows mode/path assumptions, a stale manual example count, numeric stress-count parsing and a worker teardown race. Local regression tests cover the corrections; original campaign deadlines remain unchanged.
Seven first manual example replays failed because SymPy/mpmath had disappeared from the interpreter. Restoring declared dependencies yielded 64 passing examples, repeated on final guide bytes.
The existing Ruff0.17.0 process segfaulted even on --version; Ruff0.15.6 was installed and completed lint checks.
The cached special-functions source archive was truncated. The original archive was recovered and its recorded SHA256 and ZIP CRC verified before coverage validation. Expected hashes were preserved.
An initial recovery-helper invocation lacked its companion module; fetching the current companion allowed recovery to complete.
